message.abstract: <jats:p>We study some of the concepts, protocols, and algorithms for access control in distributed systems, from a logical perspective. We account for how a principal may come to believe that another principal is making a request, either on his own or on someone else's behalf. We also provide a logical language for accesss control lists and theories for deciding whether requests should be granted.</jats:p>
title: A calculus for access control in distributed systems
